notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). In the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000072971-26-000133, filed February 24, 2026) the short 10-K document (wfc-20251231_d2.htm) holds the cover, Item 1 and Item 5, and the financial statements are in the filing's annual-report document wfc-20251231.htm. Ownership comes from the 2026 proxy statement (accession 0000072971-26-000200), as of February 9, 2026. CHARLES SCHARF (Chairman, CEO and President; chairman since October 2025, per the 10-K's executive officer list): 1,118,702 shares; the proxy has no percentage column for individuals and states that none of them owns more than 1%, so pctEconomic is null. His unvested RSRs (590,782) and target PSAs (927,147) are not counted. HOLDERS: the percentages are as printed in the 2026 proxy, but each rests on a 13G/A as of December 2023 (Vanguard, BlackRock) or September 2024 (FMR); the percentages rose because the share count fell. DIVIDENDS are common-stock dividends only; Wells Fargo separately paid $1,050 million of preferred dividends (excluded). BUYBACKS are common-stock repurchases only; $2,000 million of preferred stock redemptions are excluded. GEOGRAPHY is null: Wells Fargo's segment note reports operating segments only and gives no revenue by geography. XBRL: the stock-comp figure is tagged us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation (the cash-flow add-back, also $1,476 million), which equals the note total.

taxes.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet, net of refunds, from the income-tax note's table by jurisdiction (U.S. federal 560; U.S. state and local and non-U.S. the rest; total 1,419 million); from FY2025 it no longer appears in the supplemental cash-flow disclosures. R&D not reported as a separate line (bank).

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0000072971-26-000133; financial statements in wfc-20251231.htm). Bank: paidOut null, altPaidOut = noninterest expense − D&A − SBC + income taxes paid. Operating cash flow was negative (−19,001), driven by trading and loans-held-for-sale flows, which is why the formula is not used. D&A is premises-and-equipment depreciation (1.7bn as stated in the accounting-policy note, the DepreciationAndAmortization fact); the cash-flow add-back 'Depreciation, amortization and accretion' includes securities and loan accretion and is not comparable, so it is not used. SBC is the stock-based compensation credited to paid-in capital (1,476, the ShareBasedCompensation fact). The cash-flow statement has no premises-and-equipment purchase line, so capex is null. Interest paid (39,806) is shown separately.

CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, where the issuer is named 'WELLS FARGO & CO' (same CUSIP 949746101). Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 19, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens.
